purpose: Conditional ordinary eager XLSX rewrite consumer guard for the shared OOXML namespace predicate. This lane is diagnostic and supplies no primary speedup claim.
gate: No speedup threshold. Validate every raw eager source/sink/phase/output identity, compare elapsed p50/p95/p99/mean and whole-child peak RSS, and retain a separate review record for every adverse change or same-build repeat drift over 5%.

raw_identity_contract.source: result.source is explicitly null; operation_metrics.source is recursively not_applicable
raw_identity_contract.sink: bounded sink summary and measured per-sample sink vectors must reconcile exactly
raw_identity_contract.phases: operation_metrics.process, publication, materialization, and cfb_phases are recursively not_applicable; eager reports have no source-backed phase vectors
raw_identity_contract.output: result.output_sha256 is a lowercase SHA-256 digest and must be stable for matched shape/repeat identities
